name: dev_package_deps
title: List the status of a local package's dependencies

origin.description: List the status of the dependencies of a local package.
origin.usage: dev_package_deps(pkgdir = ".", dependencies = NA, repos = getOption("repos"), type = getOption("pkgType"))

arguments.name: pkgdir
arguments.text: Path to a package directory, or to a package tarball.

arguments.name: dependencies
arguments.text: Which DESCRIPTION fields local_package_deps reads. A length-1 logical NA selects Depends, Imports, and LinkingTo.

arguments.name: repos
arguments.text: Repository URLs, passed to package_deps after any Additional_repositories field is appended.

arguments.name: type
arguments.text: Package type passed to package_deps. source reads the CRAN source index.

origin.details: Calls local_package_deps, then package_deps on those names. The recursive CRAN walk still uses Depends, Imports, and LinkingTo. A package with no Remotes field does not look up GitHub. Additional repositories named in the DESCRIPTION are appended. A Bioconductor package, one with a biocviews field, gains any missing Bioconductor repositories. Rows are matched on the package name and the last copy is kept.
origin.value: A data frame with columns package, installed, available, diff, and is_cran.
origin.example:
.libPaths(c(path.expand("~/R/library"), .libPaths()))
dir <- tempfile()
dir.create(dir)
writeLines(c(
  "Package: toydeps",
  "Version: 0.0.1",
  "Imports: remotes"
), file.path(dir, "DESCRIPTION"))
x <- dev_package_deps(dir, repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org", type = "source")
row <- x[1, ]
cat(paste0(
  "dev_package_deps returns ", row$package,
  ", installed ", row$installed,
  ", available ", row$available,
  ", diff ", row$diff,
  ", cran ", if (isTRUE(row$is_cran)) "TRUE" else "FALSE",
  ".\n"
))

translation.description: List the status of the dependencies of a local package.

arguments.name: pkgdir
arguments.text: Path to a package directory, or to a package tarball.

arguments.name: dependencies
arguments.text: Which DESCRIPTION fields local_package_deps reads. The NA object selects Depends, Imports, and LinkingTo.

arguments.name: repos
arguments.text: Repository URL or URLs, passed to package_deps. None uses https://cloud.r-project.org. Additional_repositories from the DESCRIPTION are appended.

arguments.name: type
arguments.text: source reads the CRAN source index. Another type raises invalid 'type'.

translation.details: Calls local_package_deps, then package_deps on those names. The recursive CRAN walk still uses Depends, Imports, and LinkingTo. A package with no Remotes field does not look up GitHub. A DESCRIPTION that contains a Remotes field raises ValueError instead of fetching that host. A biocviews field adds Bioconductor repository URLs whose names are not already present. Rows keep the last copy of each package name.
translation.value: A list of dicts with keys package, installed, available, diff, and is_cran.
translation.example:
import os
import tempfile
from remotes.deps import dev_package_deps

directory = tempfile.mkdtemp()
with open(os.path.join(directory, "DESCRIPTION"), "w", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
    handle.write("Package: toydeps\nVersion: 0.0.1\nImports: remotes\n")
rows = dev_package_deps(directory, repos="https://cloud.r-project.org", type="source")
row = rows[0]
cran = "TRUE" if row["is_cran"] else "FALSE"
print(
    "dev_package_deps returns "
    + row["package"]
    + ", installed "
    + row["installed"]
    + ", available "
    + row["available"]
    + ", diff "
    + str(row["diff"])
    + ", cran "
    + cran
    + "."
)
